segments.title: The Invisible Giant
segments.hook: Did you know that a black hole is like a cosmic vacuum cleaner sucking in everything around it?
segments.script: Black holes aren't like the monsters of sci-fi, but they do have an immense gravitational pull! Anything that gets too close, even light, can't escape. Imagine a massive void in space with a strong appetite!
segments.visual_cue: Show an animation of a swirling galaxy with a black hole at the center, pulling in stars and light.

segments.title: Journey to the Heart of Darkness
segments.hook: Ever wondered what you'd see if you fell into a black hole?
segments.script: Approaching a black hole would be a wild ride! As you get closer, time slows due to its intense gravity. Get too near and you'd experience 'spaghettification' – being stretched into thin strands! Yikes!
segments.visual_cue: Animate a character falling towards a black hole, showing time dilation effects and stretching as they get closer.

segments.title: Birth of a Black Hole
segments.hook: How does a black hole come into existence? It's more explosive than you think!
segments.script: Black holes are born from the ashes of massive stars. When these giants collapse under their gravity, they explode in a supernova. The core compresses into something so dense that it warps space and time!
segments.visual_cue: Show a massive star exploding into a supernova, then zoom into the collapsing core forming a black hole.
